title: The Beetle Bus and the Crooked Road
synopsis: A seedpod-sized garden bus meets a fallen leaf across its road and takes a new route to deliver its passengers home.

related_resources.reason: The garden-scale vehicle and repeated stops use explicitly imaginative storytelling to invite playful prediction.
The three familiar stops and repeated bus bell provide an optional refrain during shared narration.
